test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

There are 9 members M, N, O, P, Q, R, S, T and U, in a joint family. There are three married couples in the family. N is a doctor and the brother of O and P. Q is the mother of S. T is the wife of M, and M is the grandfather of S. O is the only daughter of M. U is the daughter of P and R.

Who is the wife of the doctor?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: There are 9 members M, N, O, P, Q, R, S, T and U, in a joint family. There are three married couples in the family.

1) N is a doctor and the brother of O and P.

2) O is the only daughter of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e8fa5fb0933bd42b2040af8a3cafabcf9b674b20757c404ecab2b3d66ba6d5a.png] 

3) U is the daughter of P and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a9d85a8255f0b996d40e1524b29002508e207b55df9ec3d1a369d79105d9bad.png] 

4) T is the wife of M, and M is the grandfather of S. 

5) Q is the mother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07bbc6ef6871b04eaa6dd343c0c7e5eccb343c4f6999bc954aa0562a41418cf5.png] 

Thus, Q is the Doctor's i.e. N's wife.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
